title: specstride report rows (F153-FR-039 to -041; data-model.md D6)
description: The rows of the read-only report in its opt-in --json form. A pure projection of events and control-plane records: unclosed attempts are shown as unclosed, unknowns are null, no duration is imputed, no manual critic split is printed (L-3), no secret can appear (F153-FR-003 ingress holds for every string here). The command writes no file (F129-FR-015 precedent). PROPOSAL of spec 153.

endCause.$comment: a member of §X.6 row 272, or null while the attempt is unclosed — never guessed

durationMs.$comment: only where an event or record carries it; null otherwise

concurrent.$comment: the F148 flag; parallel durations are flagged, never averaged away

rule.$comment: the rule id of the decision that produced this row (F153-FR-008)
